purpose: Test whether future admissibility organization depends on accumulated prior deviations rather than only the immediately previous state.
hypothesis: If deviated constraint dynamics are non-Markov, then history-preserving runs should diverge from last-state-only controls under matched current conditions.
success_condition: Full-history runs show measurable predictive or organizational divergence from matched last-state-only controls.
failure_condition: Current state fully predicts future organization with no added value from accumulated admissibility history.
